name: VoteHub Polling API
summary: US political polling data aggregated from many pollsters: approval, favorability, generic-ballot and race polls with their source links.
notes: Keyless and free; a beta API whose endpoints and coverage are still growing.
Data is licensed CC BY 4.0: credit VoteHub when you use it, and each poll carries the URL of its original source.
In the docs sample_size appears as a string in some responses; parse it before comparing.

endpoints.name: List polls
endpoints.summary: US political polls (approval, favorability, generic ballot, races) with pollster, dates, sample size, population, source URL and answers.

poll_type.description: Exact poll type, e.g. approval, generic-ballot, favorability (see poll_types.list).

subject.description: Poll subject, e.g. a politician's name; dashes and spaces are interchangeable (see subjects.list).

from_date.description: Polls ending on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

to_date.description: Polls ending on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

population.description: rv registered voters, lv likely voters, a all adults/voters.

notes: With no filters it returns every poll in the database; filter by poll_type and subject or dates.

endpoints.name: List pollsters
endpoints.summary: Every distinct pollster name in the database.

endpoints.name: List poll subjects
endpoints.summary: Subjects with the poll types available for each, i.e. which subject and poll_type filters combine.

endpoints.name: List poll types
endpoints.summary: Every distinct poll type, such as approval, favorability and generic-ballot.
